rules.reason: Console is the graph's sink: it registers every module's commands and nothing may import it back, or the widest fan-in in the codebase becomes a cycle. A module that needs to describe console behaviour injects Shared\Facade\ConsoleFacadeInterface instead. See src/php/Console/CLAUDE.md.
Filesystem is the compiler's only Provider entry. ADR 0004 accepts Compiler, Config, Filesystem, Lang and Shared loading together as one kernel; the compiler reaches no module outside that group.
Filesystem is a leaf: no Provider, no facade dependencies, and its only module import is the Config data model. See src/php/Filesystem/CLAUDE.md.
Fiber depends on nothing beyond the Lang leaf: no Provider and no cross-module facades. See src/php/Fiber/CLAUDE.md.
Command has no facade dependencies. Its single compiler import is the type-only EvaluatedCodeException instanceof check; it injects no compiler facade. See src/php/Command/CLAUDE.md.
